answer: A farm running 173 keys hence burns for 173 separate budgets, and each of them has to be real to survive a spot-check of the violet declaration. Because the river audit recomputes usage from the harbor history, a padded declaration is a losing trade rather than a inexpensive one. Each identity declares a compute budget of 260 units per epoch and the declaration is bound to its signing key, so two identities cannot share one budget without a visible collision. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
